page_title: BAR 4-0 RSO | Barcelona v Real Sociedad 02/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's the end of the match.
90' 2 additional min. will be played.
90' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
88' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
86' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the right post.
86' Barcelona take a short corner kick.
85' Hector Fort (Barcelona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
84' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
83' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Now Barcelona have a corner.
83' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 26:0.
80' Barcelona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

80' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal despite being in a difficult position, but his shot is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
79' Barcelona hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
77' Imanol Alguacil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) replacing Orri Oskarsson.
76' Ronald Araujo goes off the pitch and Hector Fort (Barcelona) comes on.
75' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
73' Real Sociedad seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
73' The attendance for today's match is 46324.
71' Dani Olmo will be replaced by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
69' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
65' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is penalised for a foul. Alejandro Quintero had a clear view and blows his whistle.
65' The resulting set piece from Barcelona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
64' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Jon Aramburu and he is replaced by Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad).
64' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Barcelona force a corner. They send men into the box.
64' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
60' 4 - 0 Goal! Ronald Araujo takes aim and his effort deflects off Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) to beat the goalkeeper. 4:0.
59' A substitution has been made. Raphinha goes off and Ferran Torres (Barcelona) comes on.
59' Hansi Flick decides to make a substitution. Pedri will be replaced by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona).
59' The referee signals a substitution. Eric Garcia (Barcelona) is brought on as a substitute for Pau Cubarsi.
56' 3 - 0 Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
56' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
56' Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
55' It should have been a goal! Pedri (Barcelona) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
55' Marc Casado (Barcelona) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
54' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes.
50' Close! Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post.
48' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
47' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
46' The game is over for Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad). Benat Turrientes comes on for the second half.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is replaced by Arkaitz Mariezkurrena.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+1' What a wasted opportunity by Dani Olmo (Barcelona)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Alex Remiro makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
45' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
43' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Raphinha (Barcelona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

42' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Barcelona get a corner.
39' Raphinha (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

39' Pedri (Barcelona) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball would have probably ended inside the right post, if Alex Remiro hadn't made a superb save. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
34' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
31' The corner by Raphinha (Barcelona) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
29' 2 - 0 Goal! Dani Olmo takes aim and his effort deflects off Marc Casado (Barcelona) to beat the goalkeeper. 2:0.
28' Raphinha (Barcelona) launches a cross from the corner, but Alex Remiro is alert to thwart the effort.
28' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Barcelona.
25' 1 - 0 Spectacular goal! Gerard Martin (Barcelona) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
23' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle as Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
22' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
21' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Dani Olmo (Barcelona) inside the box.
20' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Pedri (Barcelona) takes it short.
20' Imanol Alguacil makes a tactical change due to a red card. Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) comes on in place of Jon Ander Olasagasti.
19' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Barcelona have a corner.
17' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) makes an ugly tackle on his opponent and is sent off by the referee!
15' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
11' Pedri (Barcelona) takes the corner but it's cleared.
8' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Alex Remiro comes off his line to intercept.
7' The Barcelona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
4' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
2' Marc Casado (Barcelona) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
